newsitem.title: DENMARK: No major risk of Danish economy overheating - report.
newsitem.headline: No major risk of Danish economy overheating - report.

text.p: Denmark's economy ministry said on Tuesday it saw no increased risk of the economy overheating in recent months, despite new forecasts of falling unemployment.
The ministry published its latest economic survey, the first since October, cutting previous unemployment estimates to 8.8 percent in 1996, 8.0 percent in 1997 and 7.6 percent in 1998.
In October the ministry predicted 1996 jobless at 8.9 percent with next year's unemployed falling to 8.4 percent of the workforce.

"The (unemployment) data received since our October survey does not point to any growing risk of overheating, but it does mean that greater surveillance will be needed," the ministry said in its report.
